prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1040; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured reports the other vehicle drifted into their lane on the highway. Insured vehicle has rear quarter panel damage and the driver reports a head strike against the window. Claimant is the other driver. Claimant reports neck pain and a headache following the collision and states they have not retained an attorney. Recorded statement requested.

Entry 2: Recorded statement obtained from the claimant. Claimant describes being struck on the driver side while merging and says they were briefly dazed at the scene. Claimant was evaluated at an urgent care facility and was diagnosed with a concussion. Claimant reports ongoing dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating at work. Claimant has not yet provided medical records. Requested signed authorization for release of records.

Entry 3: Scene photos and police report reviewed. Report notes both vehicles sustained sideswipe damage and that the other driver was cited for failure to maintain lane. Witness statement from a passenger in the insured vehicle is consistent with the citation. Liability appears to lean toward the other driver, pending final review. Claimant has been advised in writing of the right to seek legal counsel and of the claims process timeline.

Entry 4: Claimant contacted the office to ask about medical payments coverage and rental reimbursement. Explained available coverage options under the policy and the documentation needed for each. Claimant confirmed receipt of the authorization form and said the records would be sent within the week. Claimant's symptoms reported as unchanged. Follow-up scheduled to review the records once received.

Entry 5: Medical records received and reviewed. Records confirm the concussion diagnosis and recommend a period of reduced activity and a follow-up with a neurologist. Claimant has been referred for further evaluation. Reserve for bodily injury reviewed and adjusted to reflect the diagnosis. Claim remains open pending the neurology report and final repair estimate. Next review set for when the specialist's findings are available.
